discription: A pulsing sawtooth wave synth with a slight detune and an amplitude LFO, creating a gentle tremolo effect.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=0.002, tremoloRate=4, tremoloDepth=0.1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.3, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var saw1 = Saw.ar(freq); var saw2 = Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune)); var tremolo = LFCub.ar(tremoloRate, 0, (1 - tremoloDepth), 1); sig = (saw1 + saw2) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env * tremolo; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
